      "name": "kernel",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Modifies libbitcoinkernel callback dispatching in bitcoinkernel.cpp/h, kernel wrapper, and test_kernel.cpp.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.7,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Fixes a deadlock where libbitcoinkernel applications hang if their log callback re-entrantly logs or triggers garbage collection that destroys logging objects. The PR notes that without this fix, Python garbage collection destroying a chainstate manager during callbacks causes hangs, as demonstrated by the new hanging test cases."
    },

      "name": "tools",

      "band": "Unranked",

      "reason_tag": "cleanup",
      "rationale": "A mechanical update to bitcoin-chainstate following a kernel API change does not make this a tools PR."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Modifies src/util/btcsignals.h to use StdMutex instead of the default mutex primitive to prevent recursive deadlocks during lock debugging.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.35,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Switches btcsignals to use StdMutex to avoid recursive deadlocks when lock-debugging checks attempt to log. This is a worthwhile correctness fix to a shared utility primitive, though secondary to the kernel API problem."
    }
